items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Another reason is John Charlie Creath's band. Creath is back.

ctx.x: Another reason is John Charlie Creath's band. Creath is back.
And we were corresponding and Zutty said he just didn't like New Orleans, he just wanted come back to St. Louis. And I told Charlie, Charlie said tell him to come on, I'll give him a job. Any day.
